summary: First-finish smoke pass. Backend: all 11 endpoint groups tested via public URL (23/23 checks pass) including /config, lecture CRUD, transcript file write, PATCH append, AI summary (3772-char output + key_points), test generation (8 questions, 4 MCQ + 2 TF + 2 short, valid answer formats), grading (100% on all-correct / 0% on all-wrong), lists, stats, delete. Frontend: Dashboard -> /record (paste mode) -> create lecture -> Generate notes -> Generate test -> answer 8 questions -> Submit -> Score view with 8 per-question review items. All data-testids resolve. Note: dashboard CTA testid is cta-record and cta-library (not cta-start-recording as stated in the review request), but they work correctly.
passed: POST /api/lectures/{id}/summary returns summary >200 chars (3772) + non-empty key_points
POST /api/lectures/{id}/test returns exactly 8 questions with mixed types (4 mcq / 2 tf / 2 short); MCQ answers A-D; TF answers True/False
POST /api/tests/{id}/grade: score=100 for all-correct, score decreases (to 0) for all-wrong
Dashboard loads with stats tiles + Recent lectures list; CTAs navigate to /record and /library
RecordPage: mode-mic/paste/upload switching works; paste-mode create-lecture flow navigates to /lecture/{id}
LecturePage: generate-summary-btn populates summary-view; generate-test-btn navigates to /lecture/{id}/test/{testId}
TestPage renders 8 questions across MCQ/TF/short; option button state visually updates on click; submit-test-btn shows score-value + 8 review-{qid} items with correct/incorrect indicators
action_items: Minor doc mismatch only: review request mentions cta-start-recording, but code uses cta-record / cta-library. No fix required unless you want to align naming.
